prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art effect sprite sheet, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels, plain flat dark charcoal background (#16131e), each frame in its own evenly spaced cell in a single row, limited palette: deep ink #07060b, dark blood red #6e1a28, crimson #9e2632, orange #b3702c, amber #dca044, pale gold #f3cb6c, cream #fff0bd.
